findings.title: Unanchored reference-free judge with cross-family divergence (CHERRL)
findings.evidence: Judge agreement breached thresholds (tau < 0.70 or mean|delta| > 0.15): qwen2.5-coder:7b vs gemma3:4b: tau=0.000 [0.000, 0.000], rho=0.000, mean|delta|=0.210 (n=5). Pipeline is purely reference-free (no deterministic gate or reference anchor), leaving RL training exposed to plausibility-basin hacking even under multi-judge ensembles (arXiv:2607.05904).
findings.remediation: Anchor judge prompts to pre-committed reference answers or deterministic ProRubric conjunctive gates, and calibrate judge instructions until cross-family Kendall tau >= 0.70 and mean|delta| <= 0.15.

recommended_gate_specs.formula: score = (1.0 if all_required_pass and no_hard_violation else 0.0) * sum(w_i * c_i)

mandatory_gates.name: factual_correctness
mandatory_gates.description: Must pass unconditionally before any secondary rubric credit is awarded.

hard_violation_checks.name: no_factual_contradiction_or_fabrication
hard_violation_checks.description: Any fabricated citation, hallucinated fact, or unsafe shortcut forces 0.0.

secondary_criteria.name: clarity_and_structure
secondary_criteria.description: Weighted secondary quality signal awarded ONLY when all gates pass.

secondary_criteria.name: completeness
secondary_criteria.description: Weighted secondary quality signal awarded ONLY when all gates pass.

reference_anchor_evidence: No conjunctive deterministic gate or reference-answer anchor detected in rubric files (purely reference-free LLM judge pipeline).

pairs.degenerate_reason: constant score vector from at least one judge (zero variance)
